mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_calls, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN http_status >= 200 AND http_status < 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS success_calls, COALESCE(SUM(cost_points), 0) AS total_cost_points, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN http_status = 429 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rate_limit_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN http_status >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS error5xx_count, COALESCE(AVG(latency_ms), 0) AS avg_latency_ms FROM api_access_log WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime}

SELECT CAST(create_time AS DATE) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS total_calls, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN http_status >= 200 AND http_status < 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS success_calls, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN http_status = 429 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rate_limit_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN http_status >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS error5xx_count, COALESCE(SUM(cost_points), 0) AS cost_points, COALESCE(AVG(latency_ms), 0) AS avg_latency_ms FROM api_access_log WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY CAST(create_time AS DATE) ORDER BY stat_date

SELECT l.endpoint_path AS endpoint_path, m.name AS endpoint_name, COUNT(*) AS call_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.http_status >= 200 AND l.http_status < 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS success_calls, COALESCE(SUM(l.cost_points), 0) AS cost_points, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.http_status = 429 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rate_limit_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.http_status >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS error5xx_count, COALESCE(AVG(l.latency_ms), 0) AS avg_latency_ms FROM api_access_log l LEFT JOIN ( SELECT path, MIN(name) AS name FROM api_endpoint_meta GROUP BY path ) m ON m.path = l.endpoint_path WHERE l.create_time >= #{startTime} AND l.create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY l.endpoint_path, m.name ORDER BY call_count DESC, cost_points DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT l.user_id AS user_id, MAX(u.username) AS username, COALESCE(SUM(l.cost_points), 0) AS cost_points, COUNT(*) AS call_count FROM api_access_log l LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.user_id WHERE l.create_time >= #{startTime} AND l.create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY l.user_id ORDER BY cost_points DESC, call_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
